Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We are ready to proceed via an AWS private offer, but we need to confirm a couple items before our procurement team will move forward:

- Term length: our finance team prefers a 36-month commitment (for amortization), but procurement will push back if the approval path is complex. Can you confirm if AWS marketplace supports 3-year private offers and whether Redwood has any standard pricing tiers for 24 vs 36 months?
- Pricing: ballpark discount we discussed was 15-20% off list for multi-year. Need a firm table we can share with procurement.
- Buyer approvals: will Cloudfolio's purchaser need buyer-side approvals only, or is there additional AWS approval required on your end? Any playbook for buyer approval steps would help.

Attached: Cloudfolio_po_request.pdf (procurement form) — this includes billing entity and SOW reference.

We'd like to close by the end of next week if possible.

Cheers,
Ben

Looping you both in — Ben from Cloudfolio wants to understand term support (36mo?) and the buyer approval path for an AWS private offer. Quick summary of what I think we can offer and questions: 

- Options: 12mo (standard) @ list-10% / 24mo @ list-15% / 36mo @ list-20% (draft figures, need approval).
- AWS marketplace: I believe 36mo is supported but long terms sometimes require seller ops involvement and increased paperwork.
- Buyer-side approvals: procurement will sign/issue PO, but AWS private-offer fulfillment also requires the buyer to accept the private offer on the AWS console. If we have to route through AWS seller support it can add 2-3 business days.

Requesting:
1) Rishi — can you confirm discount ceilings and whether 20% is approvable without VP sign-off?
2) Laura — any legal/finance considerations for 36mo (rev rec, cancellation language) we should flag to the buyer now?

Attaching a draft pricing sheet for internal review (pricing_summary.xlsx).

Tessa Morgan

Subject: Re: Private Offer: term length & buyer approval path for Cloudfolio

Thanks for the ping, Tessa — copied my notes below so we have a clear approval matrix.

Internal approval matrix (sales discounts / term approvals):
- <$200k ARR commit: AE or Sales Manager sign-off (no exec sign-off needed).
- $200k-$500k ARR commit or discounts >15%: requires Sales Director sign-off.
- >$500k ARR commit or discounts >25%: requires VP / Revenue Ops approval and Finance review.

Notes on term length & marketplace:
- AWS Marketplace supports private offers up to 36 months, but 36mo requires us to engage Seller Support for contract setup in some regions; timeline +3 business days on top of signing.
- For customer ease and to reduce procurement friction I recommend 24mo with an option for renewal (Auto-Renew or a 30-day pre-notice) and a prepay option (annual prepay) — that often reduces buyer legal pushback and simplifies revenue recognition.
- Finance: if customer wants 36mo with deferred billing we need Finance signoff for revenue recognition and collections; Laura, please confirm any red flags (especially around cancellation credits).
- Co-sell: if Cloudfolio wants AWS co-sell we should loop the AWS GTM manager early; they like 12-24mo private offers for co-sell eligibility.

Rishi
Sr. Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: approval_matrix.pdf (pdf)

Ben — thanks for the details and the procurement form. Quick summary and suggested path that should keep approvals light and speed up execution: 

- Proposal we can present to procurement: 24-month private offer, 15% off list, annual billing (option to prepay year 1). This stays below our 20% director-level threshold and should avoid VP sign-off for the expected spend you quoted on the call.
- If you still prefer 36 months, we can do 20% but will need Finance + Seller Support engagement and it may add ~3 business days to the fulfillment timeline.

Next steps for Cloudfolio to keep the timeline to ~1 week:
1) Confirm preferred term (24mo / 36mo) and billing entity (use form you attached).
2) Confirm whether you want annual invoice or prepay for year 1.
3) If you approve 24mo @15%, I'll generate the private offer and send the DocuSign link/send to AWS private-offer flow (you'll accept the offer in the AWS console).

Attachments: Cloudfolio_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_summary.xlsx (revised with 24mo/36mo rows).
